message.content:
A) **Fail.** The footer currently renders as a flat, edge-to-edge strip that is visually anchored to the bottom of the viewport. It lacks the "floating" quality described in the brief; there is no visible soft shadow underneath it to lift it off the page background, and the background appears as a solid dark fill rather than a translucent or reflective glass slab.

B) **Fail.** The top edge of the footer is defined only by a thin, dashed jade green line (the inlay). It completely lacks the bright, solid highlight on the top-left edge required to create an embossed, 3D lighting effect. Without this highlight and a corresponding shaded far edge, the element reads as a 2D graphic border rather than a raised physical object.

C) **Fail.** The footer has sharp, 90-degree corners where it meets the sides of the screen. The brief explicitly requested rounded corners matching the app's 16px radius (seen in the cards above), but the footer ignores this, maintaining a rigid rectangular shape.

D) **Verdict: FAIL.** The implementation misses the core "embossed glass tray" aesthetic. To pass, it needs significant visual upgrades: adding border-radius for rounding, implementing box-shadows for the floating effect and edge shading, applying a bright top-left border highlight, and potentially adding a diagonal gradient sheen to simulate glass. Currently, it functions only as a minimal, flat status bar.
